content.title: What is Personal Care? - YouTube
content.text: 👉 Download our free ebook: https://www.visitingangels.com/ebook Many seniors wish to age at home, but mobility and health issues can make that difficult. Personal care services from Visiting Angels offer non-medical support like bathing, grooming, meal prep, and more—helping older adults stay independent and safe at home. Learn how tailored, in-home care supports dignity and routine. 📍 Chapters: 0:00 – Why Aging at Home Matters Introduction to the importance of aging in place and the challenges seniors may face. 0:22 – What Is Personal Care? Definition and goals of non-medical personal care services for seniors. 0:40 – Types of Personal Care Assistance Overview of services offered: bathing, grooming, dressing, meal prep, and more. 1:00 – Benefits of In-Home Care from Visiting Angels How personalized support helps seniors thrive at home safely and independently. 1:12 – How to Learn More Call to action: like, comment, subscribe, and download the free eBook for more info. #SeniorCare #AgingInPlace #HomeCareServices Not all services are available at all locations.
